Name: Simple NPC Paths
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[size=4]Simple NPC Paths[/size]
Hold a chest, machine, fence, or furniture to highlight known NPC walking routes in red. Hover your placement preview over a highlighted tile to see which NPCs use it, helping you keep their paths clear.
[size=4]
Features[/size]
• Highlights known NPC walking routes.
• Shows NPC names when placing items on their paths.

[left][b][size=4]New in 1.1[/size][/b][/left]
• Choose your own shortcut to show or hide paths, even with empty hands. No key is assigned by default.
• Optional Generic Mod Config Menu support for easy in-game settings.
• Turn off “Show automatically while placing” for key-only control.

“Remember previous days” includes routes recorded on earlier days, helping you keep those paths clear too. Turn it off to show only today’s routes.

[size=4]Compatibility[/size]
Uses routes calculated by the game with your installed maps and NPC schedules, including custom NPCs that use standard pathfinding. No changes are made to NPC schedules or movement.


[size=4]Requirements[/size]
Stardew Valley 1.6.15 or later.
SMAPI 4.4.0 or later.

[size=4]Installation[/size]
Extract the SimpleNpcPaths folder into your Mods folder and launch the game through SMAPI.

[size=4]Please note[/size]
Highlights show known routes, so other days and seasons may differ. Unmarked tiles aren’t guaranteed safe. The mod warns you but still lets you place items.
